title: Where Each Online Orders Delivery Service Ships
content:
Not every Online Orders delivery service reaches every address. The service area of each service, and whether it can ship to Alaska or Hawaii, to a PO box or to a military address, are fixed as follows.

## Service areas

| Delivery service | Destinations served |
|---|---|
| Economy Ground | All 50 states, DC, PO boxes and APO, FPO and DPO military addresses |
| Pickup Point Delivery | UPS Access Point locations in all 50 states and DC |
| Standard Ground | Street addresses in all 50 states and DC |
| Expedited 2-Day | Street addresses in all 50 states and DC |
| Next Business Day | Street addresses in the contiguous 48 states and DC |
| Same-Day Courier | ZIP codes on the Same-Day metro list |

## Address types by service

| Delivery service | Alaska or Hawaii | PO box | APO, FPO or DPO |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Pickup Point Delivery | Yes | No | No |
| Standard Ground | Yes | No | No |
| Expedited 2-Day | Yes | No | No |
| Next Business Day | No | No | No |
| Same-Day Courier | No | No | No |

## Reading the matrix

- Economy Ground is the only Online Orders service that delivers to a PO box or to an APO, FPO or DPO address.
- Pickup Point Delivery delivers to a UPS Access Point rather than to the customer's street address; it reaches Alaska and Hawaii through Access Points there.
- Next Business Day stops at the contiguous 48 states and DC, so an Alaska or Hawaii address is outside it.
- Same-Day Courier serves only ZIP codes on the Same-Day metro list.
